notes.title: Traffic Jams brings traffic chaos to Oculus Quest, PlayStation VR and Major PC VR Platforms in September!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33738013/a4b36c921eaa97ea91b0f2fe86cea83fbf533e31.jpg[/img]

[h1]Get your first hands-on with the first level of Traffic Jams in the demo on Steam![/h1]

In the world of Traffic Jams all traffic lights have gone out and you are the only one who can keep traffic flowing in the face of outrageous events and flagrant road rage. You start off in the quiet town of Gouda, but as you progress, traffic control job offers soon start pouring in from iconic cities around the globe. 

Rude pedestrians, impatient drivers, and the occasional meteorite will be yours to control before road rage strikes. Yes, you read that right; meteorites! But those aren’t the only hazards; This chaotic VR game is full of monsters, (un)natural disasters, and something called… ‘cheese bowling’?

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1301930/Traffic_Jams/

During the [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-Z9Zp9wzha0][b]UploadVR Summer Showcase[/b][/url], we've announced couch party mode! Share the fun of VR with up to four friends (read: frenemies), locally, on mobile devices! Have a look at the multiplayer trailer featuring none other than VR content creators [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCN0FGqUt7e79xKoPAZQ8tww][b]Cas & Chary[/b][/url]!


[h1]Meet Dennis, your instructor.[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33738013/935f8e316a856f68af08343962adf863670f55b1.jpg[/img]

Dennis is your greatest frenemy, your rival, but most importantly, for better or for worse, your teacher. Hailing from Jam City, the self-proclaimed "best traffic controller...EVER", takes you under his wing. His experience comes from the many flash mobs and packed intersections that his hometown is known for. Armed with dreams of superstardom, a sassy attitude and fresh dance moves, he has taken it upon himself to teach YOU the ropes of traffic controlling.

If you give him a chance, (and the occasional dance), he'll take you on a jam-packed global adventure to become the Ultimate Traffic Showman.

This is only the first glimpse of the cities you’ll be handling in Traffic Jams, as there will be many different challenges, each with their own crazy events to face on this worldwide trip! We hope to see you on the crossroads for the full release; Traffic Jams will be available for Oculus Quest, PlayStation VR and all major PC VR platforms in September 2020.

For more news about Traffic Jams, find us on [url=http://facebook.com/vertigogames]Facebook[/url], [url=http://twitter.com/vertigogames]Twitter[/url] and [url=http://instagram.com/vertigogames]Instagram[/url] to stay up to date on all things Traffic Jams, and sign up for the newsletter at trafficjams-vr.com

notes.title: Revealed: Post-apocalyptic VR Action FPS "After the Fall"
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33738013/b2e888000ffc2edb61bfc1ccc16311ad2270ef7e.jpg[/img]

[h1]Survive a vast, hostile world with seamless cooperative multiplayer made for VR[/h1]

We’re excited to finally reveal our biggest VR game yet: After the Fall, an epic, post-apocalyptic multiplayer VR action FPS. Survive a vast, hostile world with seamless co-op gameplay at its core.

Set in the post-apocalyptic, ice-covered ruins of an alternate 1980s Los Angeles, in After the Fall you play in a team of up to four players, against a vast, hostile world in a raging fight for control of the city and the survival of humanity. Go solo or join forces with players worldwide as you scavenge the remains of civilization, face relentless hordes and larger-than-life bosses, craft a huge range of guns and deadly close combat weapons, and wield devastating powers with real-life movements.

[url=https://youtu.be/_0kknW-iADw]Watch the E3 trailer here.[/url]

After the Fall combines an unprecedented VR world shared with players worldwide, a cinematic and atmospheric campaign, action-packed solo and multiplayer gameplay, and endgame built from the ground up for VR. You can register for beta access for a chance to play at [url=http://afterthefall-vr.com]http://afterthefall-vr.com[/url].

[b]A word from our Studio Director, Richard Stitselaar[/b]
“Arizona Sunshine was one of the first full-feature games developed exclusively for VR. Ever since, we’ve been eager to take it up a few notches and push hard at the boundaries of VR again. With After the Fall, we’re bringing VR to life at a scale we believe hasn’t been done before – a seamless multiplayer experience set in a dynamic, changing world that will keep players coming back for more.”

After the Fall is coming to VR in 2020.  

For more news about After the Fall and to register for a chance at beta access, please visit [url=http://afterthefall-vr.com]http://afterthefall-vr.com[/url], find us on [url=https://www.facebook.com/AfterTheFallVR]Facebook[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/AfterTheFallVR]Twitter[/url], and wishlist the game on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/751630/After_the_Fall/]Steam[/url]

notes.title: Update 1.0.8538
notes.content:
[b]Balancing:[/b]
[list]
[*] Decreased the range of the Flying Fortress from 6 to 4
[*] Decreased the attack cooldown for the Hellbeast from 0.5 to 0.3 and Increased its speed From 1.25 to 1.4
[/list]

[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Decks are no longer shuffled before a battle (initial cards in the players hand appear in the order of the deck collection).
[*] Added voice language option to the options menu, separate from the text language.
[*] Fixed an issue where the AI difficulty setting would show up in the options menu.
[*] Fixed an issue where (in some languages) the tooltip title text overlapped with the stat value text.
[*] Fixed an issue where player could become stuck in the "Logging in..." screen.
[*] Fixed small issues with the user interface.
[/list]

notes.title: Announcing Skyworld: Kingdom Brawl!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33738013/2c670b1cf8d26641665b7671647fcec7b6017536.jpg[/img]

We're proud to announce [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/977690/Skyworld_Kingdom_Brawl/]Skyworld: Kingdom Brawl[/url], a highly competitive, cross-platform multiplayer VR card-battler from the creators of Arizona Sunshine. For the first time, PC VR and standalone VR players will join together as the game launches with full cross-platform support on April 2, 2019.

Watch the announcement teaser trailer:
https://youtu.be/fYjGAHF3qR4
Wishlist on Steam [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/977690/Skyworld_Kingdom_Brawl]here[/url].

From the creators of Arizona Sunshine, set in the Skyworld universe, Skyworld: Kingdom Brawl is an action-packed, real-time multiplayer card-battler that will turn best friends into foes, built exclusively for VR. 

Unlock, collect and upgrade dozens of cards to build a powerful deck, and watch your cards come to life as you cast spells and summon forces to wipe your enemy off the map. Join a clan, take on opponents from around the globe in regular online tournaments, and claim your place on the global leaderboards. This is no friendly battle… this is war!

Skyworld: Kingdom Brawl will launch for HTC Vive (Pro), HTC Vive Focus, Oculus Rift and Windows Mixed Reality headsets on April 2, 2019, followed by a Vive Focus Plus launch later this year. 

For more information, wishlist [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/977690/Skyworld_Kingdom_Brawl]Skyworld: Kingdom Brawl[/url] and find us on [url=http://facebook.com/vertigogames]Facebook[/url] and [url=http://twitter.com/vertigo_games]Twitter[/url]. See you on the battlefield soon!
